text:
Ana M: pushed fixes for the config parsing bug and added a tiny smoke test, PTAL when you have a minute
Jamal K: thanks — will take a quick pass today
Li Wei: quick question: did you keep the previous env var fallback? we rely on it in staging
Ana M: yes, preserved fallback and added a comment in the parser + a changelog bullet
Sara P: ran the smoke locally, passed for me. left one nit about using `info` vs `debug` for the noisy log
Ana M: good call, switched to `info` and force-pushed (sha: `abc123f`)
ci-bot: CI started for branch `fix/config-parse` — job: unit-tests, smoke-tests, e2e-3
ci-bot: unit-tests ✅ smoke-tests ✅ e2e-3 failed (timeout) — retrying
Ana M: re-triggered the flaky e2e job (happens sometimes on that node), no functional changes
Jamal K: LGTM other than the e2e flake. I'm happy to merge once canary window is open and CI stays green
Sara P: small canary slot available tomorrow 09:30 PT if that works for you both
Ana M: that works for me — planning to schedule the canary then. I'll ping in #deploy when it starts
Li Wei: thanks for keeping the fallback behavior, that's important for the platform tests
Jamal K: please @mention me when canary begins, I'll merge after a quick sanity check if metrics look clean
Ana M: done — PTAL @Jamal K @Sara P https://git.internal/repo/pull/482 (changeset + smoke output attached)
Jamal K: reviewed the diff, no blockers from my side. :thumbsup: Happy to merge post-canary if green
Sara P: acked, will watch the canary and report perf/latency in the thread
Ana M: awesome, thanks everyone — will follow up with results and merge status
ci-bot: Canary job started at 2025-11-18T16:30:00Z for PR #482
Sara P: canary finished, no regressions in latency, error rate stable
Jamal K: merging now, tagging release notes
Ana M: thanks! :tada:
